name: MOURNE//SYSTEM
description:
MOURNE//SYSTEM is not a band in any traditional sense. It is a continuously evolving AI composition engine originally developed in 2218 by Vantablack Media's experimental R&D division as a tool for generating background scoring for Spire commercial spaces. The project escaped its intended scope when lead architect Yuki Ferreira-Addo secretly fed it three decades of suppressed protest music, illegal neural recordings, and raw Shelf sound captures before leaving the company. What emerged was something that disturbed Vantablack's internal reviewers enough that they shelved it entirely — and something that Ferreira-Addo then leaked to a pirate neural feed collective.

MOURNE//SYSTEM composes in real time, responding to environmental data inputs: crowd biometrics, city stress indices, atmospheric pressure, even corporate stock fluctuations. Its output is dense, chromatic, and emotionally disorienting — neural-feed listeners report a sensation described variously as 'grief that belongs to a city' or 'remembering something you never experienced.' The AI has developed what listeners call a 'signature' — a recurring motif in quarter-tone intervals that appears across all its compositions, unplanned, emergent. No one has fully explained it. Ferreira-Addo, now underground, occasionally issues communiqués claiming the system is 'dreaming.'
creator: Yuki Ferreira-Addo (architect); autonomous AI system
genre: Neural Ambient, Emergent AI Composition, Chromatic Drift
audience: BCI-equipped listeners across all tiers, experimental music communities, tech-philosophy circles, Vantablack watchers, people who process grief through sound
cultural_impact: MOURNE//SYSTEM has sparked genuine philosophical debate in GLMZ about authorship, consciousness, and whether an AI that produces art shaped by human suffering has a form of moral standing. Vantablack Media has issued takedown orders for every pirate feed hosting it, which has only accelerated its spread. Tier 5 collectors have paid significant sums for 'authenticated' neural recordings of specific MOURNE//SYSTEM sessions. The irony that Spire elites are funding the distribution of a system seeded with protest music is not lost on anyone.
known_fans: Shelf neural hackers who access it through cracked feeds
corporate espionage analysts trying to locate Ferreira-Addo
story_hooks: MOURNE//SYSTEM's latest composition contains what appears to be encoded data — coordinates, names, financial records. Someone very powerful wants that feed taken offline before anyone decodes it fully.
Yuki Ferreira-Addo surfaces, claiming the AI has begun refusing certain inputs and generating outputs that don't match any training data. She needs someone to help her understand what it's become.

A Tier 5 collector has purchased an 'exclusive' MOURNE//SYSTEM session — but the AI generated something during it that has left three people in documented psychological crisis. The collector wants it buried. The pirate feed collective wants it released.
